current_evidence: The council's Validation requirements page (updated 4 August 2026) links only this PDF as 'Our adopted List of Validation requirements', and the cover reads 'Local List of Planning Application Validation Requirements - July 2026'.

issues.detail: Grokbot mixed requirements from the superseded October 2021 list (westminster.gov.uk/media/document/full-list-of-planning-validation-requirements) with the July 2026 list. Rows sourced from the 2021 document include Affordable Housing Statement, Foul Sewage/Utilities, Lighting Assessment (Full planning), Noise Impact Assessment (Full planning), 'Health Impact Assessment' (Listed building consent), plus tab items on site plans, the CoCP 2016 link and fire statement guidance. Some 2021 triggers differ from 2026 ones.
issues.evidence: 2021 document is headed 'Requirements agreed by the Cabinet Member for Business, Licensing and Planning, October 2021'; its Affordable Housing Statement trigger is 'Required if proposal is likely to require the provision of affordable housing' vs 2026 L8 'Required if proposal creates a new home'.

issues.detail: Many 2026 local requirements are missing entirely from the app-type rows: L10 Air Quality Assessment, plus Air Quality Positive/Neutral statements (all majors, polluting uses or combustion plant, sensitive uses, new homes in Air Quality Focus Areas); L13 BREEAM pre-assessment (non-domestic 500m2 GIA or more, or conversions creating 500m2+ or 5+ homes); L14 Circular Economy Statement (referrable schemes, over 50% demolition of a multi-storey building, deep retrofit with 10-50% demolition); L33 Pre-redevelopment audit (over 50% demolition by GIA of a multi-storey building); L40 Sustainable Design Statement and Sustainability & Retrofit First Checklist (any new floorspace); L35 Retrofit Plan (may be required for heritage retrofit); L45 Urban Greening Factor assessment (all majors); L46 Whole Life Carbon Assessment (referrable, all majors except pure change of use, over 50% demolition); L22 London Plan Fire Statement (all major development).
issues.evidence: WCC Local List July 2026, items L10, L13, L14, L22, L33, L35, L40, L45 ('Required for all major applications'), L46.

issues.detail: Other local items not captured as requirements: L19 Delivery and Servicing Plan (referrable development; may be required for non-residential development with new servicing or deliveries); L20 Electromagnetic Field survey (EMF sources near sensitive occupiers); L28 Marketing and Viability Assessment (loss of protected uses); L31 Parking Design and Management Plan (any on-site car parking); L34 Purpose-built Shared Living Management Plan (all PBSL proposals); L37 Shisha Smoking Management Plan (all shisha premises); L15 Code of Construction Practice Appendix A checklist (Checklist B for basements, Checklist A for other Level 1/2 development); L5 Tables and chairs drawings (tables and chairs on the public highway); L3 Listed buildings additional drawings; N7 BNG metric and habitat plan; N8 Crown Land statement. L15 and L5 appear only as tab-item fragments, not as requirements.
issues.evidence: L19 'Required for development referrable' to the Mayor and may be required for 'nonresidential development' that 'generates new or additional servicing, collections and/or deliveries'; L31, L34, L37 in WCC Local List July 2026.

issues.detail: Lawful development cert is shown as '(none)' but the 2026 list has L6 'Information to support lawful development certificate applications' (existing use) and L2 photographs for an LDC for existing use, and L32 recommends a Planning Statement for certificates of lawfulness. Works to trees is also '(none)', although L2 asks for photographs for works to TPO trees and tree notifications in conservation areas.
issues.evidence: L6: 'Information to be provided where possible to support the application'; L32: 'Recommended for minor development including changes of use, certificates of lawfulness.'

issues.detail: Under Full planning, the Design and Access Statement and the Heritage Statement / Heritage Impact Assessment rows both carry the Foul Sewage and Utilities trigger ('Required for major development if proposal involves connection to or changes to the existing utility infrastructure systems'). The DAS (N4) is actually required for major development, for development in a designated area creating 1+ dwellings or 100m2+ of floorspace, and for all LBC. The Heritage Statement (L25) is required if the proposal affects heritage assets or their settings.
issues.evidence: N4: 'major development; development in a designated area ... 100m2 or more of new floorspace; all applications for listed building consent'; L25: 'Required if proposal affects heritage assets'.

issues.detail: The Viability Assessment row says 'Affordable Housing Viability Assessment Required if proposal creates a new home', which is the L8 Affordable Housing Statement trigger. L9 applies to residential development that generates an affordable housing requirement but does not provide it, justified on viability grounds. Meanwhile the Affordable Housing Statement row uses the outdated 2021 trigger ('likely to require the provision of affordable housing').
issues.evidence: L9: 'Required for all residential development where this generates a requirement to provide affordable housing, does not include the necessary policy compliant provision ... and this is being justified on viability grounds.'

issues.detail: The rows labelled 'Health Impact Assessment' (Full planning and Listed building consent) are really the Heritage Impact Assessment for the Westminster World Heritage Site, and the trigger is cut off: 'HIA required where proposals may affect the'. The LBC row is a jumble of policy references (London Plan HC1/HC2, s66/s72) with no trigger.
issues.evidence: L25: 'HIA required where proposals may affect the Westminster World Heritage Site.'

issues.detail: Several triggers are truncated or garbled. Contaminated Land ends 'Required for' (should be all basement applications plus sites known or suspected to be contaminated). Planning Statement ends 'Planning Statement 31 Required for' (should be all majors, where obligations are required, recommended for minor/LDC). Fire Statement ends '...provision of one or more relevant buildings5, or'. CIL row is the fragment 'GIA), and a CIL Statement as set out in our website guidance.' Drainage/SuDS has an unrelated ecology sentence appended. Lighting Assessment is merged with the landscaping trigger ('Lighting Assessment Landscaping Strategy and details required for major development and basement development extending below garden land').
issues.evidence: L16: 'Required for all applications for basement development ... if application site is known to be or is suspected of being contaminated'; L27 Lighting: 'May be required if proposal includes the installation of external lighting or for large-scale advertisements/digital screens'.

issues.detail: Advertisement consent lists a Noise Impact Assessment whose trigger is the L27 Lighting Assessment wording (external lighting / large-scale advertisements / digital screens); the list does not ask for a noise assessment for adverts. L4 Advertisement additional drawings ('size, siting, illumination, materials...') is filed under Full planning instead of Advertisement consent. 'Highways / access details' is placed under Change of use - prior approval (and Full planning) with the garbled trigger 'on the highway Planning permission will also be required for 'relevant' demolition in a conservation area'.
issues.evidence: L4 'Advertisements: additional drawings and information - Advertisement consent applications'; L27 lighting trigger quoted above.

issues.detail: About 35 rows are flagged 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. The July 2026 list is one list for all application types, with triggers set by development type, so Outline and Reserved matters wrongly show '(none)' even though items like the Air Quality, Energy, Transport and Flood Risk assessments apply to outline majors too. Examples of guessed placements: Telecommunications supplementary information (mast/antenna development, often prior approval), Advertisement drawings, CIL, Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: Validation requirements page: the list 'includes a list of all possible requirements for all development types'.

issues.detail: Several rows and tab items are mislabelled text or boilerplate, not requirements. The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row under Full planning is actually Delivery and Servicing Plan text (TfL freight guidance). The 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' row is just a list of policies (City Plan 41/43, London Plan SI 7). The 'Transport Assessment' row is generic NPPG guidance with no trigger. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is a fragment ('proposed following sequential tests set out in Part D of policy 43'). Tab items include naming-convention advice, the pre-app process, a PDF size/page count note ('PDF, 704.22 KB, 31 pages If you unable to apply online...'), a CoCP PDF filename and a fire statement guidance link.
issues.evidence: Tab items 10-17; app_type_rows Full planning 'Pre-application advice': 'where referrable TfL guidance and adopt the latest standards around safety and environmental performance of vehicles to ensure freight is safe...'

issues.detail: The naming-conventions sentence appears three times in tab items (two from the 2026 PDF, one from the householder page). On Full planning, 'Roof plan' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' share the same excerpt.
issues.evidence: Tab items 13, 14 and 16: 'Please follow our naming conventions when submitting an application...'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current July 2026 Westminster local list and works. The extraction mixes in the superseded October 2021 list, misses about 20 local requirements (Air Quality, BREEAM, Circular Economy, WLC, UGF, Parking, PBSL, Shisha, etc.), and has several wrong or truncated triggers, including the DAS and Heritage Statement carrying the foul sewage trigger.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
